rationale: First-cut robust design screened with balanced mirrors (S_mp3/S_mp1 = 2*S_mn5/S_mn4 = 6), I_tail~71uA, I_2~228uA, Cc=0.8pF, Rc=3.5k to achieve LHP zero cancellation of p2 at 62MHz. Expect all TT specs to pass and SS corner to bind on UGBW/PM.

Increase mn4=8, mn5=24 to boost stage 1 and stage 2 gm, wp1=wp3=2.5um to reduce mirror pole capacitance, cap=0.8pF, res=3.0k to achieve robust UGBW >= 100 MHz in all 12 corners and push PM to ~55-60 deg. Screened worst-case UGBW=101.3M, PM=55.0 deg, worst FOM=-0.0287.

wn1=1.5um reduces gate-drain overlap and input capacitance, optimizing PM to >60.4 deg across all corners while Rc=3.0k maintains UGBW=101.9M at SS 1V 100C. Corner check verified feasible in all 12 corners with FoM=0.4249.
